title: Dave's Hot Chicken Files Plans for First Laredo Location
excerpt: Dave's Hot Chicken has filed plans for its first Laredo restaurant, at 2102 NE Bob Bullock Loop, with construction set to begin in January 2027.
content:
Dave's Hot Chicken is coming to Laredo. The Nashville-style hot chicken chain has filed plans for its first restaurant in the city, at 2102 NE Bob Bullock Loop, the Laredo Morning Times reported Tuesday.

The plans were filed Monday, Nov. 23, according to 365 Things Laredo, which first shared the filing. Construction is scheduled to begin Jan. 9, 2027, with completion expected Aug. 9, 2027, according to the announcement.

The chain is known for hot chicken tenders and sliders served at spice levels ranging from no spice to extra hot. The Laredo restaurant would be the chain's first in the city.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 24, 2026; 365 Things Laredo, Nov. 23, 2026.
